cases.description: Checklist item 2 (compatibility check result reviewed): the fixture's downstream skill has no SKILL.md at all, so the declared upstream_context_marker can never be confirmed present — the compatibility checker correctly flags exactly one issue, and real execution is blocked outright (both steps SKIPPED) rather than proceeding on a wiring assumption that might no longer hold. This is the case that most directly demonstrates ADR-020's fail-closed default is not just a step-failure behavior but also a pre-execution gate.
cases.grounding: compatibility_checker.check_template returns one CompatibilityIssue when the downstream skill's SKILL.md is missing entirely; executor.run_workflow refuses to run any step when compatibility_issues is non-empty and dry_run is False.
